Rooftop Snipers is a free, chaotic 2D physics-based browser and mobile game developed by New Eich Games where two characters duel on rooftops by trying to knock each other off. 
Gameplay and Mechanics
Objective: The first player to reach 5 points by successfully shooting or knocking their rival off the edge of the building wins.
Two-Button Controls: Players cannot walk or run manually. Instead, you press one key to jump (and dodge) and hold another key to aim your weapon, releasing it to fire. Player 1 uses W to jump and E to shoot, while Player 2 uses I and O.
Physics & Recoil: Exaggerated ragdoll physics and weapon recoil mean that firing a gun or getting hit can throw off your balance and cause you to tumble off the roof yourself.
Modes: You can play solo against the computer or locally with a friend in a two-player mode.
Random Elements: Matches feature rotating pixel-art stages, unpredictable items like beach balls or tomahawks, and quirky character skins including icons like Batman, The Joker, Mr. T, and Voldemort.
